title: 経営戦略と組織
subtitle: Managenemt Strategy
educationalGoal: Explain basic terms and concepts such as management strategy, customers, values, businesses, core competencies, etc. and the relationship between the words. Basics for corporate activities, business management, and business strategies to be explained as the basic concept and tools.
advice: This course is a basic course for achieving the management and marketing goals of the management and information department, which are the learning and educational goals. A wide range of knowledge and skills are used for management and marketing, learning through example analysis, quizzes, and simple exercises. In particular, customers, stakeholders, competitive advantage, and core would be understood as basic terms and concepts. In this course, we will also build human resources with knowledge and skills of IT passport examination. Deepen understanding of terms and concepts in the field of "strategy" will be shared with "F103 IT system basics".
requiredKnowledge: What is corporate activity? What is a corporate organization? What are Manegement, Strategy and Marketing in corporate activities? are the basic objectives of this course. Please continually update on the necessity to collect, analyze and understand social examples and informationof economic activities. In this lecture, What to do if the student is a business owner? Since you will learn the basics of the countermeasures and you will have a sense of ownership during active participation and discussion in this lectures.

activityGoals.body: Understand the company, its purpose, and organization.
Understand the basic knowledge of Manegement.
Understand the basic knowledge of Strategy.
Understand the basic knowledge of Marketing.
Understand the items necessary for considering management strategy and organization.
